description: exp 001 adam baseline (constant Adam 1e-3, raw l2 readout): the canonical RND control
exp 002 sgd1t baseline (eta0 1e-2, t0 1e2): prior work's best; per-env agg slopes -0.80 vs -0.38 expose the heterogeneity
exp 003 sgd1t + initial-copy readout norm: start_dev exactly 0 (requirement 1 solved); slopes unchanged, worst position now a near-flat curve
exp 004 const SGD + Polyak-averaged sqrt readout: slope_mean -0.45 but center_square nearly flat in-window (agg -0.10); heterogeneous (std 0.44)
exp 005 functional shrink w/ sqrt schedule: inner Adam OVERSHOOTS the near target (fixed-size steps), acts like fast distillation; slope -1.8. Retry with inner SGD + tolerance
exp 006 SGD-1/t + inverse-squared-error reweighting: spread not reduced (std 0.69)
exp 007 AdaGrad + initial-copy readout: NEW LEADER. agg slopes -0.510/-0.499 on both envs, tightest spread (std 0.106); worst position still -1.39
exp 008 sphere-projected inputs + AdaGrad: kills the radial rate gradient on cell_midpoints but collapses center_square points to near-identical inputs (agg -1.35 there)
exp 009 AdaGrad lr 3e-3: best dev_mean so far (0.32); smaller early drop; worst-position outlier remains (-1.42)
exp 010 linear head + exact min-change interpolation + residual-encoded shrink r->r/sqrt(1+r^2): SOLVES the uniform benchmark; slope -0.500000 at every position, residue = the (n+1 vs n) off-by-one

exp 011 = exp-010 method under NONUNIFORM visitation: does NOT track per-position counts — every position follows the same aggregate curve (slope vs global step -0.5002 +- 0.0004); feature interference drags unvisited positions along. Key negative finding
exp 012 AdaGrad 3e-3 under NONUNIFORM: mildly count-sensitive (slope_mean -0.78 vs global step), better dev_mean than exp 011 but still far from per-count tracking

exp 013 MLP + per-sample shrink targets + inner SGD: mean slope right (-0.51) but slow kernel modes stay under-shrunk (center_square agg -0.22) — gradient inner fitting cannot realize the functional shrink uniformly; the exact solve is load-bearing
exp 014 coin-flip RLS on zero-bias ReLU features, uniform: features are rank-deficient (106/108, condition 1e10) so the head cannot reach per-position coin means; readout saturates
exp 015 same under nonuniform: same representational failure
exp 016 coin-flip RLS on RBF features (sigma 0.75), uniform: cell_midpoints agg -0.5013; weakness = center_square under-spanned by the fixed bandwidth (slope range -0.93..-0.26)
exp 017 same under NONUNIFORM: best nonuniform result so far (prev 1.41); genuine per-position count tracking through coin statistics + local features
exp 018 shrink on fixed RBF, NONUNIFORM: 1.08 — locality helps (was 1.47) but the recurrence integrates interference drift
exp 019 coin-flip + adaptive dictionary, uniform: 0.053, near the chi floor at d=512
exp 020 same, NONUNIFORM: 0.455 — best nonuniform so far; genuine per-position count tracking
exp 021 same, dense_grid 432 points: 0.059 — adaptive dictionary absorbs the capacity stress
exp 022 coin-flip fixed-RBF on dense_grid: 1.40 — fixed bandwidth hits the resolution wall the adaptive dictionary removes
exp 023 shrink + global ReLU on dense_grid (432 > 256 features): 0.038 — the residual-encoded map SELF-CORRECTS realization error (shrink factor reads the achieved state), no capacity wall
exp 024 shrink + adaptive dictionary, uniform: matches exp 010 exactly
exp 025 same, NONUNIFORM: 1.31 — the multiplicative recurrence integrates minibatch interference drift; least-squares statistics (exp 020) average it out instead
exp 026 same, dense_grid: exact again
exp 027 closed-form elliptical posterior on adaptive dictionary, uniform: 0.202 — slope near-perfect; deviation = neighboring-cell feature overlap inflating effective counts
exp 028 same, NONUNIFORM: 0.535 — comparable to coin-flip; overlap-count inflation is the gap
exp 029 elliptical adaptive on dense_grid: 0.126 — capacity absorbed
exp 030 quartic loss constant step, uniform: slope -0.40 +- 0.05 with level spread — the honest schedule-free pure-gradient approximation
exp 031 same, NONUNIFORM: 0.84 — inherits the level spread
exp 032 elliptical with bandwidth cap 0.35, uniform: 0.114 (was 0.202) — overlap-count inflation halved
exp 033 same, NONUNIFORM: 0.478 — just behind coin-flip
exp 034 scrambled-Hadamard coin sequences on the adaptive dictionary: locally machine-exact min(1, n^-1/2) at every position; validation runs val_109-111 carry its measured numbers
